execution_data_identity: Per-fold SHA-256 over ordered Open/Close prices and timestamps; a mismatch against the PPO report aborts comparison.
execution_alignment: All simulations start all-cash at the first test observation and first execute at the next bar Open. Static equal-weight and SPY references buy once and do not rebalance. The PPO exposure-matched equal-weight comparator rebalances at each next bar Open using only the PPO target gross exposure for that bar, distributed equally across the PPO universe. Every strategy uses the same transaction-cost and slippage rates with turnover-based costs; the static equal-weight reference also uses the PPO per-position and gross-exposure caps.
aggregation: Each benchmark is evaluated once per market fold and shared across seeds. PPO seed/fold runs remain independent; returns are not concatenated or compounded.
